posts.title: do it for me
posts.description: And as I look at your face I have so much left to say But I keep my mouth shut, though I so often Struggle to But I would do it for you and Would you do it for me? Why is this the truth Why is this how it must be? Do you quantify this in your room In the soft glow of the evening Do you stare out into the world And envision what it all still could be? Because I do it for you And you know that I do

posts.title: in the company of memories
posts.description: He looks at me and asks what I’m thinking about. We’re parked at an old boat dock, a place pulled from one of his childhood memories and I’m gazing out at the black water as he watches me from across the car. “Nothing,” I say.
